title: EntityHideAndSeek
description: A hide and seek minecraft plugin where you hide as entities (inspired by BastiGHG)
body:
EntityHideAndSeek is a plugin where one player is the seeker seeking for the other players that can hide as entities.

## How to start

### 1. Select a seeker

To select a seeker you use the `/start <player> <time HH:MM:SS>` command, which will then also automatically start the game.

The time is the period where hiders can safely hide before the seeker starts seeking them.

**example:** `/start Player 0:05:00`

**Permission:** OP or `hideandseek.start`

### 2. Disguise

Use the `/disguise <entity>` command to disguise yourself.

**example:** `/disguise cow`

---

A player can be found when hit by the seeker.
There is no time limit, but the seeker only has 10 tries (insipred by [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PhrLLM2E2K8](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PhrLLM2E2K8)).

If the seeker uses all tries before finding everyone, the hiders win, else the seeker wins.
